# `help` operations

The exact fields each `help.*` operation takes and returns.

<!-- Generated by `python scripts/codegen/docs_reference.py` from the op registry; edit the models, not this page. -->

Every op is `POST /v1/<op>` over HTTP and the MCP tool `loom_<op>`. The identity fields (`org`, `namespace`, `agent`, `user_id`, `session_id`) are filled from the token and the MCP session when a transport can; see [identities and namespaces](../../concepts/identities-and-namespaces.md). The [operations index](../operations.md) explains role, kind and the MCP `all` listing. Unknown input fields are served and named in `ignored_args`.

<!-- prettier-ignore-start -->

## `help.get`

Read one page of this build's documentation, or one section of it.

`POST /v1/help.get` · MCP `loom_help_get` · role `viewer` · read · not listed under the MCP `all` toolset

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | `''` | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `path` | `str` | required | The page, as help.search returns it (`features/knowledge.md`). |
| `section` | `str` | `''` | The section's headings, `Title > A > B`, as help.search returns it; empty for the whole page. |
| `anchor` | `str` | `''` | The section's anchor, as help.search returns it: read in place of `section`, since it is unique on its page where a heading may repeat. |
| `offset` | `int` | `0` | Where to start in the text read (the section, or the whole page), in characters: 0 by default; a cut read gives the offset its rest starts at. |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `available` | `bool` | False when this build ships no documentation to read. |
| `found` | `bool` | False when the page, or the section on it, is not in this build's documentation. |
| `path` | `str` | The page, relative to the docs root. |
| `title` | `str` | The page's title. |
| `section` | `str` | The section read, `Title > A > B`; empty for the whole page. |
| `anchor` | `str` | The section heading's anchor on the rendered page; empty for the whole page. |
| `audience` | `Literal['user', 'operator']` | `user` for using Loom, `operator` for running or building it. |
| `text` | `str` | The section with its subsections as Markdown, or the whole page, from `offset`; cut at a limit. |
| `truncated` | `bool` | True when `text` was cut; read again from `next_offset` for the rest. |
| `next_offset` | `int` | Where the rest of a cut read starts; 0 when nothing was cut. |
| `sections` | `list[HelpOutlineEntry]` | Every section of the page, in order: for a whole-page read or a cut one, else empty. |

## `help.search`

Search this build's documentation.

`POST /v1/help.search` · MCP `loom_help_search` · role `viewer` · read · not listed under the MCP `all` toolset

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | `''` | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `query` | `str` | required | What to find, in words: a question, a feature, an op or setting name. |
| `limit` | `int` | `5` | How many sections to return, best first. |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `available` | `bool` | False when this build ships no documentation to read; `hits` is then empty. |
| `hits` | `list[HelpHit]` | The best sections, best first, at most `limit`. |
